z-m-05-05.title: Zingaphi iigoli ezikwibhodi yeegoli?
z-m-05-05.goal: Thelekisa iindlela ezintathu zokubala, ugqibe ukuba yeyiphi echanekileyo phantsi kweemeko ezithini, uze ubhale ukuba kutheni sihlola impendulo ngenye indlela.
z-m-05-05.material:
Ibhodi yeegoli inemiqolo emi-5 yemingxunya, kunye nemingxunya e-6 emqolweni ngamnye (imingxunya engama-30 zizonke). Kodwa iigoli azikho kuyo yonke imingxunya, kwaye kukho imingxunya engenanto emi-3. Amanani eegoli kwimiqolo 1 ukuya kwi-5, ngolandelelwano, ngu-6, 6, 5, 5, 5. Abahlobo abathathu bafumana inani leegoli.
UGaon: "5×6=30, ngoko kukho iigoli ezingama-30."
UNarae: "Kukho imingxunya engama-30 kwaye imingxunya engenanto emi-3, ngoko 30 ukususa 3 ziigoli ezingama-27."
UDaon: "Ndibale iigoli kumqolo ngamnye ndadibanisa. 6+6+5+5+5=27 iigoli."

z-m-05-09.material: UJiho noSeoa baqala ukonga ngosuku olunye. Aba babini bathembisa ukufaka isixa esimiselweyo veki nganye, kwaye isixa sikaSeoa sahlukile kwesikaJiho. 'Imali esebhokisini yemali' engezantsi yimali epheleleyo emva kwedipozithi yeveki leyo. Idatha ivezwa ngomnye ngeveki.
z-m-05-09.thinking.0: Lungisa isigwebo sakho njengoko idatha ikhula
z-m-05-09.thinking.1: Fumana ipatheni yendlela umahluko otshintsha ngayo
z-m-05-09.prereq.2: Ukuqonda imeko enyuka ngesixa esifanayo veki nganye
z-m-05-09.s.s1.prompt: Idatha ivezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha. Ngalo lonke ixesha, khetha ingcinga yakho yokuba ngubani oza kuba nemali engakumbi.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala imali kwiibhokisi zemali ezimbini ecaleni komnye kwitheyibhile yeveki nganye, uze emva koko ufumane ubhale umahluko.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba umahluko utshintshe kangakanani veki nganye.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.0.info: Iveki 1: Ibhokisi yemali kaJiho inayo i-1000 won, kwaye ibhokisi yemali kaSeoa inayo i-500 won.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ingaba ibhokisi yemali kaJiho iya kuqhubeka ineemali ezininzi ukusuka ngoku?
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukususela kwiveki 1 yodwa, awunakuxela ukuba nganye ifaka malini veki nganye. Zombini ingqikelelo 'uphambili, ngoko mhlawumbi uza kuhlala ephambili' nesigwebo 'asikazi okwangoku' ziyafaneleka okwangoku.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.0.o.a: UJiho waqala kuqala kwaye unemali engakumbi, ngoko mhlawumbi uza kuqhubeka enayo
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Oku kuqikelela ukuba ophambili ngoku uza kuhlala ephambili. Kufuneka wazi ukuba nganye ifaka malini ngakumbi veki nganye ukuhlola oko.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.0.o.b: UJiho unayo ngakumbi ngoku, kodwa andazi ukuba ngamnye ufaka malini veki nganye, ngoko andinakumisela okwangoku
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Olu gwebo luqonda ukuba ulwazi alwanelanga yaye lulinda idatha efunekayo.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.0.o.c: USeoa uza konga ngokuzikhandla ngakumbi, ngoko uSeoa uza kuba nangakumbi
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ukuba ngubani osebenza nzima akukho kwidatha. Khangela isiseko sakho kwidatha.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ukuba bayalingana na kuxhomekeke kwisixa abasifaka veki nganye. Awukwazi ukuxela ngedatha yangoku.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Iveki yesi-2: Ibhokhwe yemali kaJiho ine-1500 won, yaye ibhokhwe yemali kaSeoa ine-1200 won. EyakaJiho ikhule nge-500 won yaye eyakaSeoa ikhule nge-700 won.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Umahluko wemali ebhokhweni utshintshe njani, yaye ucinga ukuba kuza kwenzeka ntoni okulandelayo?
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Kukho idatha entsha yokuba umahluko wancipha ukusuka kwi-500 won ukuya kwi-300 won. Okubalulekileyo kukuchaza ukuba uyancipha, yaye unokuhlola ngakumbi ukuba uncipha ngomlinganiselo ofanayo veki nganye.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Umahluko wancipha ukusuka kwi-500 won ukuya kwi-300 won. Ukuba uhlala unjalo, uSeoa usenokubanjwa
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uqikelele ikamva ngokubona ukuba umahluko uncipha veki nganye.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.o.b: UJiho usenayo i-300 won ngaphezulu, ngoko uJiho uya kuhlala enazo ngakumbi
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ujonga umahluko wangoku kuphela. Jonga nokuba umahluko wancipha njani xa kuthelekiswa neveki yoku-1.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ndiqinisekile ukuba umahluko wancipha, kodwa ndiza kudinga ukubona iveki enye ngakumbi ukwazi ukuba uncipha ngomlinganiselo ofanayo veki nganye na
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ugwebe ngononophelo, uyazi ukuba kukho idatha yeeveki ezimbini kuphela.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.o.d: USeoa ufaka i-700 won veki nganye, ngoko uSeoa uza kungekudala abe nangakumbi kunoJiho
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.1.r.d: USeoa unayo i-300 won ngaphantsi ngoku. Kufuneka ubale ukuba kuthatha iiveki ezingaphi ukumbamba.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.info: Iveki yesi-3: Ibhokhwe yemali kaJiho ine-2000 won, yaye ibhokhwe yemali kaSeoa ine-1900 won. EyakaJiho ikhule kwakhona nge-500 won yaye eyakaSeoa ikhule nge-700 won.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ukuba aba babini baqhubeka bengeza amanani afanayo kwiveki yesi-4, ngubani oya kuba nangakumbi?
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.after: Iveki yesi-4: UJiho 2500 won, uSeoa 2600 won. EyakaSeoa ikhula nge-200 won ngakumbi veki nganye, ngoko umahluko udlula kwi-500, 300, 100 won, yaye kwiveki yesi-4 uSeoa uphambili nge-100 won.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.o.a: USeoa unangakumbi. Umahluko wancipha 500, 300, 100 won, ngoko uSeoa uphambili
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uqhubeke usebenzisa umthetho apho umahluko uncipha khona (200 won ngexesha).
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.o.b: UJiho unangakumbi. Oku kungenxa yokuba uJiho usenayo i-100 won ngaphezulu
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ujonge umahluko wangoku we-100 won kuphela. Thelekisa ukuba ngamnye ufaka malini ngaphezulu kule veki.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Balinganayo. Umahluko uyancipha, ngoko okulandelayo uya kuba yi-0 won
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Umahluko uncipha nge-200 won ngexesha, ngoko ukuba umahluko ngoku yi-100 won, ixesha elilandelayo ayiyi-0 won.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Asikwazi ukuxela. Oku kungenxa yokuba asazi ukuba baza kufaka malini kwiveki yesi-4
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Aba babini baphumelele ukufaka isixa esimisiweyo veki nganye, yaye amanani afanayo akhule iiveki ezimbini ezilandelanayo. Usebenzisa esi sithembiso, unokuqikelela iveki yesi-4.
z-m-05-09.s.s1.reflect: Uqikelelo lwakho lokuqala lwahluka njani kugwebo lwakho lokugqibela? Chaza ukuba ngeyiphi idatha ingcinga yakho yatshintsha, okanye yahlala injalo.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.prompt: Ngeli xesha, misela wena icwangciso likaSeoa. UJiho aqala ngama-1000 won kwiveki yoku-1 yaye ikhula nge-500 won veki nganye (1500 kwiveki yesi-2, 2000 kwiveki yesi-3, 2500 won kwiveki yesi-4). USeoa uqala nge-s won kwiveki yoku-1 yaye ikhula nge-d won veki nganye. Bhala izibini ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo (s, d) apho uSeoa engenayo ngaphezulu kunoJiho ukuya kwiveki yesi-3 (ukulingana kuyavunyelwa) yaye uba nangaphezulu kunoJiho okokuqala kwiveki yesi-4. (s no-d zikwiiyunithi ze-100 won, s ukusuka kwi-100 ukuya kwi-1000 won, yaye d ukusuka kwi-100 ukuya kwi-1000 won.)
z-m-05-09.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala imali anayo uSeoa kwiiveki zesi-3 nesi-4 njengokubala usebenzisa s no-d.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.hint.1: Misela d kuqala, emva koko utshintshe s uze ukhangele xa zombini iimeko zisebenza.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.fail.c1: s no-d kufuneka zibe kwiiyunithi ze-100 won yaye zisuka kwi-100 ukuya kwi-1000 won.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Ukuya kwiveki yesi-3, akanayo ngaphezulu kunoJiho (ukulingana kuyavunyelwa).
z-m-05-09.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, (500, 700) inika i-1900 won kwiveki yesi-3 kunye ne-2600 won kwiveki yesi-4. (400, 700) inika i-2500 won kwiveki yesi-4, elilingana, ngoko asikuthi 'ngaphezulu,' kwaye (1000, 600) sele iphambili kwiveki yesi-3 nge-2200 won.

z-m-05-10.title: Amatye abahlobo ababini bobabini bawanyathelayo kumatye okunyathela
z-m-05-10.goal: Fumana amanani avela kuzo zombini ukubala ngokutsiba okubini ngokwenza uluhlu, khetha indlela yokuhlola ukuba umthetho ofunyenwe kumanani ambalwa unokuqhubeka na, uze wenze wena ukubala ngokutsiba okuhambelana neemeko.
z-m-05-10.material:
Kumsinga, amatye abekwe ngocwangciso lwamanani ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kuma-60. UMinseo uqala ku-0 aze atsibe izithuba ezi-3 ngexesha (3, 6, 9, ...), yaye uYuna naye uqala ku-0 atsibe izithuba ezi-5 ngexesha (5, 10, 15, ...). Amatye aba babini abafikelela kuwo ngokutsiba abizwa 'ngamatye anyatheliweyo.' Amatye ngamnye awanyathele ukuya kwilitye lama-30 ngala alandelayo.
UMinseo: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 27, 30
UYuna: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30
z-m-05-10.thinking.0: Thelekisa imithetho emibini ufumane amanani aqhelekileyo
z-m-05-10.s.s1.prompt: Khetha onke amatye, ukuya kwilitye lama-30, ababenyathele kuwo bobabini.
z-m-05-10.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula amanani avela kuzo zombini uluhlu.
z-m-05-10.s.s1.r.a: UMinseo kuphela unyathele kwilitye le-6. Hlola ukuba likuluhlu lukaYuna na.
z-m-05-10.s.s1.r.c: UYuna kuphela unyathele kwilitye lama-20. Hlola ukuba likuluhlu lukaMinseo na.
z-m-05-10.s.s1.explain: Amatye e-15 nama-30 akuzo zombini uluhlu.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.prompt: Amatye aba babini abawanyathelayo bobabini esiwafumeneyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku ngamatye e-15 nama-30. Ungakholelwa njani ukuba ilitye elilandelayo aba babini abalinyathelayo liya kuba lilitye lama-45?
z-m-05-10.s.s2.hint.0: Qhubeka noluhlu lukaMinseo emva kwelitye lama-30.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.hint.1: Qhubeka noluhlu lukaYuna nalo, ukusuka emva kwelitye lama-30 ukuya kwilitye lama-45, uze uthelekise.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.o.a: Ujonga ezimbini, kukhule nge-15, ngoko ilitye lama-45 liqinisekile
z-m-05-10.s.s2.r.a: Ukuba uthi liqinisekile ngezimbini nje, awuzange uhlole ukuba lingatshintsha okulandelayo.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.o.b: Ezimbini azisixeleli nto yaye akukho ndlela yokuhlola
z-m-05-10.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba uqhubeka noluhlu ukuya kwilitye lama-45, unokuhlola.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.o.c: Qhubeka noluhlu ukuhlola ukuba ilitye lama-45 livela kuzo zombini uluhlu
z-m-05-10.s.s2.o.d: Liya kuba lilitye lama-35. Oku kungenxa yokuba uYuna utsiba nge-5
z-m-05-10.s.s2.r.d: Jonga kuluhlu lukaMinseo ukuhlola ukuba ilitye lama-35 liyalinye uYuna kuphela alinyathelayo.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.explain: Ukuba uqhubeka noluhlu lwabo bobabini ukuya kwilitye lama-45, uMinseo ufikelela kwilitye lama-45 (3×15) yaye uYuna ufikelela kwilitye lama-45 (5×9). Ukuba uhlola ngoluhlu, unokukholelwa uqikelelo.
z-m-05-10.s.s3.prompt: Ngeli xesha, misela wena ubukhulu botsiba bamahlobo amabini. Bobabini baqala kwilitye le-0, yaye ubukhulu botsiba p no-q ngamanani ahlukeneyo ukusuka ku-2 ukuya ku-6 (p incinci kuno-q). Bhala izibini ezi-4 ezahlukeneyo (p, q) apho ilitye lokuqala abalinyathelayo bobabini lilitye lama-20 okanye ngaphantsi.

z-m-05-10.s.s3.hint.1: Kwanele ukubhala uluhlu kuphela ide livele inani elifanayo okokuqala.
z-m-05-10.s.s3.hint.2: Bhala uluhlu kuphela ukuya kwilitye lama-20 uze uhlole ukuba likho inani elinegqithelayo.
z-m-05-10.s.s3.ok.c1: Zisuka ku-2 ukuya ku-6 yaye p incinci kuno-q.
